title: Adressage et rénovation urbaine – Abidjan
publisher: Ministère de la Construction, du Logement et de l'Urbanisme
why: Q2: Official PADA/PAVI description with central address centre and address database, 2025 figures, participating services, and interior-city rollout; says the system is not yet fully effective.

title: Côte d'Ivoire: 14,000 Abidjan roads to receive signs
why: Q4: Address format (number, road name, postal code), central address centre and database, 400,000 surveyed units, post/utilities/cadastre/navigation users, planned extension beyond Abidjan.

title: Projet d'Adressage du District autonome d'Abidjan : à ce jour, 14 279 voies ont été identifiées
why: Q1: Council of Ministers status of Abidjan addressing, 14,279 roads identified, and validation of a numeric national address code; completion pending.

title: Adressage des voies dans le District autonome d'Abidjan: l'opération prend fin le 31 décembre
why: Q3: Current Abidjan coverage excluding precarious neighbourhoods; expansion to about 15 cities by 2030, not the whole country.

title: Le BNETD entame l'adressage de la commune de Daloa
why: Q1: Fieldwork under way in Daloa on street and door numbering and street-name signs; interior cities Daloa, Bouaké, Korhogo.

title: Adressage des rues: consolidation de la base de données d'adresses
why: Q4: Official digital address database and geoportal, address-certificate workflow, intended integration with BNETD, INS, La Poste, cadastre, network operators.

title: Projet d'adressage du district d'Abidjan – PADA
why: Q2: Describes 2021-2024 PADA: numbering, street naming, address database and portal, 13 communes, sharing with DGI, INS, network operators and La Poste.

title: What3words: système de géolocalisation
why: Q2: La Poste runs a live three-word geolocation address service for delivery; a complementary locator, not a full street-address register.
